tei:div.tei:p: 319)chos nyid mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod las: rtsa gsum spyi gces dngos grub len chog 'dod dgu'i char 'bebs bzhugs so: na mo gu ru dhe wa dhā ki ye: rtsa gsum lha la gus pas 'dud: mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod zab mo yi: rtsa gsum sgrub pa'i cha lag tu: 'dod dgu'i char 'bebs gdams pa bstan: skal ldan bu yis nyams su longs: sa ma ya: de yang sgrub pa'i rnal 'byor gyis: rtsa gsum gang rung gzhung bsrang rjes: thod pa mtshan ldan bcud kyi bkang: bzang drug chos sman bum rdzas btab: dar dmar kha dgab da lar bzhag: grol nyin tho rangs dang po la: las gzhung gang rung 'dzab kyi mjug: dngos grub rdzas la nus bskyed ni: rol mo dbyangs bcas 'di skad do: hūm̐ hrīḥ ka dag skye med pho brang nas: kun bzang yab yum 'khor dang bcas: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren byin chen phobs: dngos grub rdzas la nus pa skyed: rnal 'byor sgo gsum smin grol nas: dag pa sku gsum mngon gyur mdzod: rang bzhin 'od lnga'i pho brang nas: rigs lnga yab yum 'khor dang bcas: gnas 'dir= dngos grub rdzas= rnal 'byor sgo= dag pa sku gsum= mi mjed sprul pa'i gnas mchog nas: dga' rab shrī 320)seng pad+ma 'byung: gnas 'dir= dngos grub= rnal 'byor= dag pa sku gsum= rang bzhin rnam dag pho brang nas: ye shes mtsho rgyal bai ro sogs: gnas 'dir= dngos grub= rnal 'byor= dag pa= pad+ma brtsegs pa'i dur khrod nas: dbang chen he ru ka dpal dang: yi dam zhi dang khro bo'i tshogs: gnas 'dir= dngos grub= rnal 'byor= dag pa= gsang sngags drod 'dzin pho brang nas: rdo rje phag mo rgyal ba'i yum: mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas: gnas 'dir= dngos grub= rnal 'byor= dag pa= dam tshig gnyen po'i pho brang nas: chos skyong pho rgyud mo rgyud dang: dam can gter bdag rgya mtsho'i tshogs: gnas 'dir= dngos grub rdzas= rnal 'byor sgo gsum= dag pa sku gsum mngon gyur mdzod:

bgegs dang log 'dren bar chad sol: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol: oṃ gu ru dhe wa dhā ki ni sarba dharma pā la sa pā ri wa ra badz+ra sa ma ya dza dza a be sha ya pheṃ pheṃ hring hring dza dza: zhes brjod ye shes dbab pa'i lha tshogs rnams sgrub rdzas dang dbyer med par bstim par bsam la rtsa sngags mthar: kā ya sid+dhi oṃ: wāk+ka sid+dhi āḥ tsit+ta sid+dhi hūm̐: sarba sid+dhi hrīḥ 321) ci mang bzlas mthar dngos grub bskul ba ni: hoḥ chos nyid 'gyur med mtha' bral klong yangs nas: rig stong brjod bral dkyil 'khor lha tshogs dgongs: bdag cag skal ldan rnal 'byor sgrub pa pos: dkyil 'khor gsum ldan ting 'dzin dag pa yis: da ni bsnyen sgrub las sbyor mtha' ru phyin: rim gnyis zung 'jug sgrub pa pha mthar son: dbang dang dngos grub stsol ba'i dus la babs: mi gnas ye shes thugs kyi dkyil 'khor nas: lus la 'gyur med bde ba'i dngos grub stsol: ngag la tshangs dbyangs gsung gi= yid la 'khrul bral thugs kyi= yon tan re skong yid bzhin= phrin las mdzad pa mthar phyin= 'jigs pa brgyad sogs zhi ba'i= tshe dang dpal 'byor longs spyod= don gnyis mthar phyin 'ja' lus mngon 'grub nas: gdod ma'i gtan srid zin par mdzad du gsol: rtsa sngags mthar: kā ya sid+dhi oṃ: wāk+ka 322)sid+dhi āḥ tsit+ta sid+dhi hūm̐: sarba sid+dhi hrīḥ zhes brjod sgrub gtor dang rdzas rnams gnas gsum du gtug cing dngos grub zhu'o: gzhan la rdzas rnams gsang bar bya: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: ḍāk+ki'i rgya: ces pa'i dngos grub len chog zab mo 'di yang gsang grogs bim la dang chos bdag snyan grags 'jigs med dkon mchog sogs kyi pañca ka shi'i mdangs 'dzin dang rin chen gnyis pa'i skyes dang bcas te yang yang bskul ngor/ 'chol mo mdo med tha shal ba su kha badz+ra gyis mkha' 'gro'i zhal lung snyan brgyud yi ger phab pa'o//
